Welcome to the LEARNING JUNCTION on YouTube. This is a channel for everyone who wants to enjoy a wide range of animated videos. Your child however has multiple options to learn short stories, nursery rhymes, science lessons and jokes too....And everything in a fun and easy way.

Please support us by subscribing to our channel and don't forget to share the videos.

For videos go to: https://www.youtube.com/user/learningjunction/videos
Facebook page:  https://www.facebook.com/b4learningjunction?ref=hl

Thank you :)
